entities.name: Patron of the Moon
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa active during the Kami War, the great Patron Kami of the Soratami, appearing as a giant furry serpent with face masks lining its hide.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: The people for whom the Patron of the Moon is patron kami and whom it eats as offerings.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which the kami was active.

events.summary: The Patron of the Moon eats Soratami as offerings.
events.quote: It is known to eat Soratami as offerings.

relations.note: Great Patron Kami of the Soratami.
relations.quote: great Patron Kami of the Soratami
